description: List transaction rules with their conditions and actions. Returns the first 100 rules; pass offset for the next page, flagged_only for just the ones with a warning, or field to see only the rules that mention one field.

field.description: Only the rules that mention this field in a condition or an action, such as payee, amount or category.

flagged_only.description: Only the rules carrying a warning, wherever they are in the list. These are the ones worth acting on.

limit.description: How many rules to list. 100 by default, which is about 16 KB of text.

offset.description: How many rules to skip, for reading the list a page at a time.

name: get_rules
